lines.beaver_en: Welcome. What product are you looking for?
lines.learner: 주방 잡화를 보러 왔어요. 새로 출시된 냄비 있나요?
lines.en: I came to look at kitchen goods. Do you have newly released pots?
lines.roman: jubang japwareul boreo wasseoyo. saero chulsidoen naembi innayo?

lines.beaver_en: This is this month's new product. Do you also look at brands?
lines.learner: 상표보다 원산지를 먼저 봐요. 이건 어디 제품이에요?
lines.en: I check the place of origin before the brand. Where is this from?
lines.roman: sangpyoboda wonsanjireul meonjeo bwayo. igeon eodi jepumieyo?

lines.beaver_en: This product is made in Germany.
lines.en: If it's German, it's trustworthy. Is the lid German-made too?

lines.beaver_en: The lid is made in Korea. The guarantee period is two years.
lines.learner: 보증 기간이 길어서 좋네요. 가격은 얼마예요?
lines.en: Nice that the guarantee is long. How much is it?
lines.roman: bojeung gigani gireoseo jonneyo. gagyeogeun eolmayeyo?

lines.beaver: 이십만 원입니다. 고가품이지만 오래 쓰실 수 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: It's 200,000 won. It's pricey, but you can use it a long time.
lines.beaver_roman: isimman wonimnida. gogapumijiman orae sseusil su itseumnida.
lines.learner: 좀 비싸네요. 저가 제품은 금방 망가져서 고민이에요.
lines.en: It's a bit pricey. Cheap products break fast, so I'm torn.
lines.roman: jom bissaneyo. jeoga jepumeun geumbang manggajyeoseo gominieyo.

lines.beaver: 제품 고르실 때 뭘 가장 중요하게 보세요?
lines.beaver_en: What matters most to you when choosing a product?
lines.beaver_roman: jepum goreusil ttae mwol gajang jungyohage boseyo?
lines.learner: 싼 물건도 쓰기 나름이지만, 결국 품질이 중요해요.
lines.en: Cheap things depend on how you use them, but quality matters most.
lines.roman: ssan mulgeondo sseugi nareumijiman, gyeolguk pumjiri jungyohaeyo.

lines.beaver: 맞습니다. 오래 쓰는 것도 관리하기 나름입니다.
lines.beaver_en: That's right. Lasting long also depends on how you care for it.
lines.beaver_roman: matseumnida. orae sseuneun geotdo gwallihagi nareumimnida.
lines.en: I once bought from a cheap shop and regretted it.

lines.beaver_en: We only sell genuine products. You also earn mileage points.
lines.en: Great. What percent of mileage points do I earn?

lines.beaver: 오 퍼센트입니다. 포장은 어떻게 해 드릴까요?
lines.beaver_en: Five percent. How would you like it wrapped?
lines.beaver_roman: o peosenteuimnida. pojangeun eotteoke hae deurilkkayo?
lines.en: It's a gift, so please wrap it nicely in wrapping paper.
lines.roman: seonmullyongini kka pojangjiro yeppeuge ssa juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Certainly. Will you pay by card?
lines.learner: 네, 카드로 할게요. 이 브랜드 마음에 들어요.
lines.en: Yes, by card. I like this brand.
lines.roman: ne, kadeuro halgeyo. i beuraendeu maeume deureoyo.
